result.title: When Does Exploration Prevent Collapse? Three Regimes and the Path of the Reward in Self-Consistency Training
result.summary: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts a model without labels by rewarding answers that agree with the majority, but it collapses the policy onto its majority answer and can remove the correct answer from the samples. Exploration can prevent this collapse, yet its strength is chosen by trial and error, and how the training algorithm changes the required strength is unclear. We model training on a single problem as a continuous flow of the logits of a softmax policy and analyze which policies are stable as the exploration coefficient varies. Only collapsed policies are stable below a lower boundary and only policies spread over many answers above an upper boundary, and we derive these boundaries in closed form for an agreement reward with smoothing toward the uniform policy, compute them for the majority reward of TTRL on policies with one leading answer and bound them with interval arithmetic for actions on ordered bins. We prove that under exact gradients, the learning rate and, in a mean-field model, the normalization of GRPO leave these boundaries unchanged when exploration passes through them together with the reward but shift them when exploration bypasses them. Exact sums on these policies then show that a bonus for rare answers needs a coefficient above $1/\log(G-1)$ for groups of $G$ samples before the normalization and about two to three times that after it. In free-form TTRL on MATH-500, a bonus placed before the normalization prevented collapse and kept more correct answers among the samples, although it lowered pass@1.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将单题上的自一致性训练（TTRL）建模为 softmax 策略 logits 的连续流，解析推导出探索系数使策略稳定于「坍缩」与「分散」两端的上下边界，并分析学习率与 GRPO 归一化对边界的影响，最后在 MATH-500 上用罕见答案奖励做验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 探索强度与策略坍缩的边界刻画可能为 latent 推理训练中的探索系数选取、奖励归一化和样本多样性消失提供可核查线索，但其对象是纯文本 TTRL，能否迁移到 latent 状态与视觉证据筛选尚不明确。
